trackingId.title: trackingId
trackingId.description: Unique identifier associated with the client’s original request. This ID matches the value returned in the synchronous acknowledgement for the corresponding API call (create, update, or upload) and enables the client to track and reconcile webhook notifications.

reasonCode.title: reasonCode
reasonCode.description: Reason Code provided in the Case Creation request for the Dispute reason

eventType.description: Specifies the type of event that triggered this webhook notification, helping the client understand the context and purpose of the payload.
eventType.title: eventType

requestId.description: Request ID sent by client in case creation request
requestId.title: requestId

caseId.description: The unique identifier assigned to the dispute case related to this webhook event.
caseId.title: caseId

statusDescription.description: Case status description. Possible values - OP - Open; CP - Awaiting Information from Cardholder; CR - Cancelled / Rejected; CM - Closed in favour of bank; CC - Closed in favour of cardholder; CB - Chargeback submitted to Network
statusDescription.title: statusDescription

statusAsOnDate.description: This is the Date Timestamp that the status was last updated. This is in the GMT timezone with format YYYYMMDD HH:MM:SS:MMM
statusAsOnDate.title: statusAsOnDate

status.description: Status of update or upload event. eg: SUCCESS, FAILED
status.title: status

remarks.description: The latest remarks or comments  added to the dispute case id to provide additional information to the client.
remarks.title: remarks

remarksLastUpdatedOn.description: Timestamp indicating when the remarks associated with the case were last updated.
remarksLastUpdatedOn.title: remarksLastUpdatedOn
